name: Yotsuya
source:
Type: ayakashi
Skills: binding, curses
Occupation: Haori (clan leader)
Age: around 800 years old
Location: Yotsuya

[i]"Is that how you address a Haori? Such an insolent whelp."[/i]

He is the one and only ayakashi with the highest rank of Haori in Yotsuya and takes ayakashi who have caused trouble in the past under his wing. He is benevolent and cherishes his friendships, but is also intimidating when angered.

He is capable of binding, commanding, and killing with curses. Deeply invested in Tengenjibashi’s view of ayakashi, he keeps a close watch on him and sometimes ends up playfully teasing him. 

He is willing to lend a hand when asked, but demands to be paid back in return. At times, he gives Tengenjibashi various tasks to do, amusing himself with the way he reacts.

[Edited from [url=https://twitter.com/i/events/1495144875670573056]Moonchime Localization[/url]]
translation:
类型：妖怪
技能：束缚、诅咒
职业：羽织（族长）
年龄：约800岁
地点：四谷

[i]“你就是这样称呼羽织的吗？真是无礼的小鬼。”[/i]

他是四谷唯一一位地位最高的羽织，收留过去惹过麻烦的妖怪。他仁慈而珍视友情，但被激怒时也十分可怕。

他能用诅咒束缚、命令乃至杀死他人。他非常在意天元寺桥对妖怪的看法，密切关注着他，有时还会调皮地捉弄他。

有人求助时他愿意伸出援手，但要求对方以回报偿还。有时，他会交给天元寺桥各种任务，享受观察对方反应的乐趣。

[根据[url=https://twitter.com/i/events/1495144875670573056]Moonchime Localization[/url]编辑。]
